source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ας Μαΐου — «Όσιος Ιορδάνης ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the whole of it is two sentences: «Ο Όσιος Ιορδάνης ο Θαυματουργός κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη. Δεν έχουμε περισσότερες λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Οσίου.» **He is not the corpus's `jordan-the-martyr-2-february`**, who is a martyr of 1650 or 1651 kept by the Greek calendar on 2 February; this man is Όσιος, fell asleep in peace, and is kept on 2 May. A martyr and a monk who died in his bed on a different day are two men, and the corpus holds no other Jordan. **The display name is `Jordan (2 May)`** because `wonderworker` is one of this folder's `types` and `lib/honorific.js` composes the rank, so the page's epithet cannot go in the name. No year, no place, no hymn, no relic.
